description: Send a private reply (DM) in response to a comment, visible only to the commenter. Max 1000 characters. Consumes 1 interaction credit. Supported on Instagram and Facebook. Returns 501 for platforms that do not support private replies.

comment_id.description: Platform comment ID to privately reply to

post_id.description: Platform post ID containing the comment

name: social_api_private_reply_to_comment
title: Private Reply to Comment
